The inspector who prepared this estimate is:
Luka Markovic, MSC ME, CMI

Got questions? Contact Luka by phone at: 343-600-3453, or by email: luka@bustmold.com

Containment of the contaminated area with polyethylene drop sheets and zipper door(s), using negative air pressure(If permitted by actual conditions at the property), or an equivalent method, in order to prevent the cross contamination of mold spores, dust/debris and other particulates to other areas of the property.

Additionally, any personal belongings or large items which cannot be relocated within the affected area will be individually wrapped to protect them against dust and debris during the remediation process.

Removal & disposal of compromised, contaminated and/or moldy materials from the area, as assessed during the initial inspection, in accordance to mold removal guidelines
- https://iaq.is/mold-removal-guidelines

Materials which will be removed and disposed of include:
• affected, organic, non-structural components
• any other organic-based materials on an as-needed basis.

All removed materials will be properly packaged in 6ml double bags and will be appropriately disposed of in a discreet fashion.

Mold Busters' trained remediation professionals are recommended to wear dust impermeable gloves, half-face air purifying respirator (P-100), full body dust-impervious coveralls and boot covers or separate work boots. 

Price includes labor, material, travel, disposal and equipment fees.
Any additional items and areas that require removal or treatment are subject to revision and discussion with the client.

- In the case additional layers of drywall and flooring are found during the remediation project, a scope increase will be presented to the client for consideration

- Topical Treatment Process

Once the affected materials are exposed, our team will remove mold from structural surfaces using a combination of specialized cleaning methods, including manual techniques and HEPA vacuuming.

We then apply a professional two-step treatment process:

Step 1: Detailed cleaning to remove staining and restore the appearance of affected surfaces
Step 2: Application of an advanced, eco-conscious fungicide designed to eliminate mold spores and help prevent future growth

Areas and materials treated may include:

Foundation walls and floors
- structural components
- other surfaces as needed

Please note that some non-mold-related staining may remain after treatment.

All work is carried out by trained Mold Busters professionals using appropriate protective equipment and in accordance with industry standards:
- https://iaq.is/mold-removal-guidelines

Pricing includes all labor, materials, and equipment required to complete the work.

If additional affected areas are discovered during the process, any changes will be reviewed and discussed with you before proceeding.

Thorough HEPA vacuuming is conducted throughout all surfaces in the affected area in order to remove mold spores, particulates and dust.

All remaining surfaces (studs, beams, walls, floors, etc.) in the affected area will be disinfected, by concentrated fogging, using an approved fungicide. 

Additional vacuuming or HEPA air scrubbing may occur upon completion of the fogging process, along with a general cleaning of all areas traveled by Mold Busters personnel.

Mold Busters applies an advanced, two-stage mold remediation protocol, initiating with high-precision stain removal techniques to revitalize the aesthetics of affected surfaces. This is seamlessly followed by the strategic application of our proprietary fungicides, meticulously designed to eliminate mold spores, thereby ensuring your space is restored to its pristine condition and safeguarded against future contamination.

Post-remediation verification is conducted to ensure that the environment has been successfully remediated.

The final clearance inspection includes a visual inspection and an instant swab analysis.

This will be performed by the Project Supervisor upon completion of the remediation process.
